Frequently asked questions

Direct answers to the questions our team gets most often.

How much do private label supplements actually cost? +
Per-bottle cost depends on the formulation complexity, ingredient cost, and order volume. Most private label SKUs land between $4 and $15 per bottle at standard volumes. Larger volumes drive per-unit cost down. We provide transparent pricing during our consultation.
What are your minimum order quantities? +
Our minimums are intentionally low to let new brands launch without massive upfront inventory commitment. Typical MOQs are in the low hundreds of units per SKU. Larger volumes get better per-unit pricing.
How long from first conversation to first product shipping? +
Most clients launch within 8 to 12 weeks of first conversation. Once labels are approved, production takes 3 to 4 weeks. The variable is how quickly you finalize product selection and approve label design.
Do you handle FDA labeling and compliance? +
We provide FDA-compliant label templates and review your custom labels for compliance with structure-function claims, supplement facts panel requirements, and required disclaimers. Your brand is ultimately responsible for compliance, but we make it dramatically easier.
Can I see what's in the formulation before I commit? +
Yes. Full Supplement Facts panels, ingredient details, and dosing information are available for every SKU in our catalog. Many of our products are also available for sample order so you can evaluate them firsthand.
What about custom formulations? +
If you need something not in our existing catalog, our R&D team can develop custom formulations. Higher minimums, longer timeline (6 to 12 months), but full proprietary ownership of the result. See our Custom Formulation page for details.
Do you handle fulfillment? +
We ship finished, labeled product to your warehouse or to a 3PL fulfillment partner you select. We do not do direct-to-consumer fulfillment ourselves, but we work with partners that do and can recommend ones.
What's the difference between private label and custom formulation? +
Private label means putting your brand on our existing formulations. Fast (3-4 weeks after label approval), low minimums, immediate market entry. Custom formulation means developing a new product to your specifications. Slower (6-12 months), higher minimums, but proprietary ownership.
